answer: Admit each new agent only through a narrow inlet: a vouch from established peers. But every member's vouching capacity is a small quota that decays and refills slowly, so no clique can bulk-admit a swarm in one epoch. Each voucher co-signs a bond slashed if the vouchee is later unmasked as a sybil, so the social bridge into the economy carries real financial liability. An operator spinning up a thousand fakes finds admission throttled to a trickle and watches their collateral spiral downward as each exposed identity burns the sponsors who let it in.
